name: claudetto
description: Adds a lean output style, a status line command, the `setup` skill, and Jev answers for `AskUserQuestion` when a key is set. Adds hooks that deny a `Bash` command that only prints a file, check plan files for claims with no source, and check Markdown line breaks.

advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.description: Use `claudetto` (the default) for the tool `advise`, with a model, an effort, and a context that you control, and the slice turns off the advisor of Claude Code for the session. Use `builtin` for the advisor of Claude Code.

advisorModel.title: Advisor Model
advisorModel.description: The model of the tool `advise`, an alias such as `opus` or a model ID.

decide.title: Second Opinion
decide.description: Use `off` for no pick, or `jev` for Jev (it needs `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, and the questions go to the TypeSafe API). With `jev` and the key, Jev answers each `AskUserQuestion` call and the dialog does not show, unless Jev is not sure about a question.

compaction.title: Compaction
compaction.description: Use `handoff` to write a handoff file in place of the compaction summary, or `built-in` for the compaction of Claude Code.
